script.hook: Your cells have an energy budget.
script.script: Glycolysis breaks one glucose molecule into two pyruvate molecules. It happens in the cytoplasm and gives the cell a net gain of two ATP. Think of it as the opening round: some energy is spent, more comes back, and the cell keeps the profit.

key_terms.broll_prompt: One stylized glucose molecule divides into two smaller groups representing pyruvate. This is a simplified conceptual animation, not an atomically accurate structure.

script.plain_summary: Glycolysis breaks glucose into pyruvate in the cytoplasm, yielding a net two ATP.
